name: Ryoujoku Jusei Kyouiku Jisshuu
original_name: 陵辱受精 教育実習
source:
Main heroine is an intern teacher who moves to her dream with the support of her fiancé. But one day everything crushes as she is detained in the back of the school and violated by students in front of her fiancé.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名实习老师，在未婚夫的支持下，她朝着自己的梦想迈进。但有一天，一切都崩溃了，她被拘留在学校后面，并在未婚夫面前遭到学生的侵犯。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
